shadows.name: display-lift

motion.name: paired-flap-rotation
motion.purpose: Old front leaf rotates 0→-180deg while new back leaf rotates -180→0deg as one continuous paired fold.

motion.name: flap-light-lifecycle
motion.purpose: Front shade peaks during departure; back shadow and highlight release as the new face arrives.

motion.name: wheel-snap
motion.purpose: Cylindrical wheel settles at the selected option.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Flap animation and general transitions collapse while functions continue.

responsiveSizing.fitGuarantee: Viewport-height caps prevent display overflow; compact wheels narrow and the readout occupies the actual center lane without losing viewport center.

scene.technology: Generated raster background with CSS overlay
scene.motion: No WebGL, video, parallax, CSS-reconstructed sunset, or continuous background animation.

narrative.overview: GHR-01 is an enlarged split-flap timepiece exactly centered in the viewport over a selected generated desert-road sunset. An inline-size query container derives every display dimension from one capped --card-width token; side wheels share the display hinge line, actions are absolutely below, and the music dock remains horizontally centered beneath.
keyCharacteristics: Selected generated desert-road background with scrim and grain.
Flip display exactly centered vertically and horizontally.
Container-relative --card-width drives card, glyph, and colon dimensions.
Anchored Settings panel with persistent, conflict-safe Music and Time tool shortcuts.
Narrow mobile wheels and icon-only Settings trigger preserve the center lane.

rules.name: The Mechanism Is Honest Rule
rules.body: Cards retain 51%-clipped panels, 200%-height full glyphs, -100% lower offsets, pivots, paired 180-degree folds, and persistent shade overlays.

rules.name: The Signal Is Scarce Rule
rules.body: Amber signals selection and active state; ivory carries the readable primary value.

dos: Keep the flip display viewport-centered regardless of controls.
Derive cards, glyphs, and colons from the inline-size query --card-width token.
Align both wheel selection lines to the display 50% hinge and put controls absolutely below.
Use anchored shortcut settings with conflict rejection and session-only fallback feedback.
Use reduced-motion direct updates while preserving time tools.
donts: Do not use pill-tab or segmented navigation for modes.
Do not introduce independent responsive sizing for card height, glyphs, or colons.
Do not execute shortcuts on repeated keys or within text-entry controls.
Do not crop, retype, or independently align lower glyph faces.
Do not restore mode/status/scroll hints, CSS reconstructed ridges, an outer console, or visible flip chamber.
